title: Pure Earthbound

allow.Harmonic Synchro Fusion: Earthbound Prisoner Line Walker searches it by name; it turns a Prisoner Tuner and non-Tuner into an Earthbound Synchro and Fusion at once.

summary: Pure Earthbound Prisoner and Servant strategy combining DARK Fiend Tuners with the 2026 support wave and Harmonic Synchro Fusion. Supported by Earthbound Prison and Earthbound Immortal Red Nova, the deck effortlessly performs simultaneous Synchro and Fusion Summons to field wipe-heavy bosses like Earthbound Servant Geo Grasha.

summary.title: Starters
points: Earthbound Prisoner Ground Keeper on Normal or Special Summon Special Summons any Level 5 or lower Earthbound monster from your Deck or GY, and protects Earthbound monsters while a Field Spell is active.
Earthbound Prisoner Line Walker on summon searches Earthbound Prison or Harmonic Synchro Fusion from your Deck, and shuffles an Extra Deck monster into the Deck from the GY.
Earthbound Prisoner Stone Sweeper Special Summons itself from hand while any Field Spell is on the field, and discards itself to search any Level 3 or lower Fiend Tuner.
Earthbound Prison on activation negates an opponent's face-up monster's effects and grants an extra Normal Summon of an Earthbound monster each turn.

summary.title: Opening: Earthbound Prisoner Ground Keeper
steps: Normal Summon Earthbound Prisoner Ground Keeper and activate its effect to Special Summon Earthbound Prisoner Line Walker from your Deck.
Activate Line Walker's on-summon effect to search Harmonic Synchro Fusion from your Deck.
Activate Harmonic Synchro Fusion, sending Level 1 Tuner Ground Keeper and Level 3 non-Tuner Line Walker to the GY.
Simultaneously Special Summon Level 6 Synchro Earthbound Servant Geo Gremlin and Level 6 Fusion Earthbound Servant Geo Gremlina from your Extra Deck.
Trigger Geo Gremlina to search an Earthbound monster (such as Earthbound Immortal Red Nova) from your Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Earthbound Servant Geo Grasha is a Level 10 Fusion that reduces the ATK/DEF of all opponent monsters that battle an Earthbound monster to 0, and wipes all cards the opponent controls whenever a monster they control is destroyed.
Earthbound Servant Geo Gremlin targets an opponent's face-up monster to force them to either destroy it or give you LP, and performs a Fusion Summon during the Battle Phase.
Earthbound Servant Geo Kraken searches any Field Spell from Deck or GY upon summon, and destroys all monsters the opponent Special Summons from the Extra Deck while burning them for 800 per monster.
Earthbound Servant Geo Gryphon is a Level 8 Synchro that revives an Earthbound monster from your GY as a Quick Effect on either player's turn.
Earthbound Immortal Red Nova banishes itself from hand or GY to send an Earthbound Immortal from Deck to GY and Special Summon any Earthbound monster directly from your Deck or Extra Deck.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Harmonic Synchro Fusion sends a Tuner and non-Tuner you control to the GY to Special Summon both 1 Synchro Monster and 1 Fusion Monster that could be summoned using those materials.
Earthbound Fusion is a Quick-Play Fusion Spell that uses materials from hand or field, and can banish an Earthbound from GY to revive an Earthbound monster.
Earthbound Release tributes a Level 10 Earthbound monster to destroy all monsters the opponent controls and inflict burn damage equal to their combined original ATK.
Earthbound Resonance burns the opponent for 500 each time an Extra Deck monster is Special Summoned, and destroys an opponent's card when your DARK Synchro is attacked.
